effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] By placing 1 Option card with the [Onmyōjutsu] or [Plug-In] trait from your hand under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Renamon], [Kyubimon], [Taomon] or [Sakuyamon] in its name attacks, by suspending this Tamer, you may use 1 [Onmyōjutsu] or [Plug-In] trait Option card with as high or lower a use cost as that Digimon's level from under this Tamer without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
